services.title: AI & Machine Learning Solutions
services.description: We build intelligent systems that automate processes, generate insights, and help businesses make smarter decisions.
body: Intelligence is no longer a luxury; it is the core of modern business efficiency. We design and build bespoke machine learning models, natural language processing pipelines, and agentic workflows that plug directly into your business logic.

Whether you need to predict demand trends, automate cognitive back-office tasks, or build next-generation customer assistance platforms, our engineering team brings mathematical rigor and production experience to deliver solutions that go far beyond wrapper APIs.

services.title: DevOps & MLOps
services.description: We streamline development and deployment with scalable infrastructure and automated pipelines.
body: Speed is nothing without stability. We build the pipelines and infrastructure that allow your product teams to ship code with total confidence. By treating infrastructure strictly as code and introducing strict observability, we eliminate 'it works on my machine' problems.

Additionally, our MLOps practice bridges the gap between data science and operations. We establish reproducible training runs, automated model validation, and drift detection to ensure your AI systems remain robust and cost-effective in production.

services.title: Web & Software Development
services.description: We build modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications tailored to your business.
body: The web is the primary window to your business. We engineer web applications that are blisteringly fast, accessible, and designed to convert. Our front-end philosophy values performance above all, utilizing static-first rendering, modern web APIs, and carefully hydration-controlled React islands.
Behind the scenes, we develop clean, modular APIs and resilient databases capable of processing high-volume transactions, keeping your user experience smooth and uninterrupted under any load.

services.title: Cloud Services
services.description: We help businesses deploy, scale, and optimize applications across cloud platforms.
body: Scaling shouldn't mean runaway cloud bills. We design resilient cloud architectures that scale up automatically to meet traffic spikes and scale down to minimize overhead. Security and compliance are built into our design by default, utilizing strict IAM roles, VPC isolation, and end-to-end encryption.
Whether you are migrating legacy servers to the cloud or looking to leverage serverless computing for event-driven workflows, we align your infrastructure with your bottom line.

work.title: AI Automation Platform
work.description: Automated document ingestion and intelligence workflows using custom machine learning models.

sections.heading: Challenge
paragraphs: Veridia Logistics was processing thousands of international shipping manifest documents manually every single day. The manual transcription was error-prone, bottlenecked supply chain dispatch schedules, and caused significant customs delays due to minor clerical errors.

sections.heading: Solution
paragraphs: We engineered a custom AI document processing platform that integrated optical character recognition (OCR) and localized large language models (LLMs). The platform reads multi-format PDFs, extracts complex tabular shipment lists, cross-references them with customs databases, and flags anomalies directly inside a React dashboard.

sections.heading: Results
paragraphs: The system went from proof of concept to full production in under 8 weeks. It now processes over 95% of manifests without human intervention, ensuring rapid custom clearance times.

work.title: Cloud Infrastructure Setup
work.description: Zero-downtime cloud migration and automated Kubernetes orchestrations.

sections.heading: Challenge
paragraphs: Apex MedTech had critical healthcare services running on fragile on-premise servers. Deployments required hours of manual configuration and had to be done overnight to avoid outages. Furthermore, HIPAA-compliant encryption standards were not automated.

sections.heading: Solution
paragraphs: We modeled their complete server matrix into Terraform configurations, establishing a secure multi-region AWS setup. We moved their core microservices into Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) with automated horizontal pod autoscaling and automated SSL/TLS termination.

sections.heading: Results
paragraphs: The agency now deploys multiple production updates daily with zero disruption to active doctor-patient sessions. Operational infrastructure costs were slashed by optimization of server capacities.

work.title: E-Commerce System
work.description: High-performance, modular full-stack e-commerce engine powering global retail storefronts.

sections.heading: Challenge
paragraphs: Aura Retail faced severe performance bottlenecks during promotional drops, where sudden spikes in traffic led to page lag and cart drops. Their legacy monolithic system couldn't handle concurrent checkout sessions without database locks.

sections.heading: Solution
paragraphs: We rebuilt the frontend storefront using Next.js with static site generation and incremental regeneration, paired with a headless Shopify Integration. The backend checkout flow was moved to decoupled, serverless microservices on AWS Lambda with Redis caching, preventing database contention.

sections.heading: Results
paragraphs: The site saw 0% downtime during their largest seasonal product launch of the year. The page load performance jumped, resulting in a direct increase in average order value.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Britnova Technologies was founded with a simple vision — to bridge the gap between complex, emerging technology and tangible business value. We noticed that many companies were either getting lost in AI hype or running fragile legacy systems that bottlenecked growth.

We specialize in AI/ML model deployment, DevOps pipeline automations, and modern full-stack development, delivering engineering solutions that are not only powerful but also scalable and maintainable.
From startups launching their first products to growing enterprises modernizing their tech stack, we work side-by-side with product teams to turn technical concepts into production-ready software.
